finalityDecision.decision: The zero-deferred proof reads grant-level execution statuses in the equipment-grants registry, canonical completionState fields in data/reference/contests.json, and this inventory's row states. reviewedNonGaps.finding: Plan 4 closed Breeder as the sole delegated Edge; Plan 7 delivered the Breeding Workshop and is archived DONE.
Plan 2 deferred reka-ui to the design-system implementation; Plan 6 delivered it and is archived DONE.
The 60 explicitly blocked P8-092 inputs were driven to final native/guided/passive states by P8-093; the catalog records 205/40/104 with zero blocked rows.
The 40 guided catalog rows are a final state under the Plan 8 rubric: bounded GM decisions with authoritative commit, not deferrals.
The 16 explicit contest-unavailable Move identities are final canonical states with reviewed reasons, not deferrals.
CharacterSheetMove.contestStats is retained as non-authoritative description per the Plan 10 footprint disposition.
Deferred per-move animation overrides in docs/move-animations.md are presentation polish, not mechanics rows; they are outside the zero-deferred mechanics contract.
Supplement books, playtest packets, and setting packs are post-1.0 expansions per the recorded 1.0 release definition, not core deferrals.
